text.tspan: Breaking business logic, not just syntax
Enumerating attack surfaces across modern stacks
Turning application crashes into root-cause analysis
Gray-box hunting, proof-of-concept proving
Hunting race conditions, BOLA, and auth bypasses
Probing endpoints until the boundary breaks
Adversarial thinking in every test case
Stress-testing LLM guardrails and agentic workflows
Jailbreaking models to harden intelligence
Model Context Protocol (MCP) security auditing
Exposing the security illusion in AI-generated code
Automating discovery through turn-based agent swarms
Dissecting binaries in Ghidra and Radare2
Auditing control flow, registers, and memory allocations
Fuzzing binaries for unhandled edge-case panics
Tracing execution paths down to assembly level
Reversing anti-analysis and obfuscation routines
Translating high-risk exploits into verifiable remediation
Hardening cloud perimeters against lateral movement
Zero-trust architectures backed by deterministic evidence
Continuous posture validation from code to cloud
Building resilient defenses against persistent vectors
while(system.vulnerable) { exploit(); patch(); }
chmod +x /root/audit_engine
find / -name "*.secrets" -exec inspect {} +
nmap -sV -p- target.domain
curl -X POST /api/v1/auth/bypass
